question: What is the build number of the latest Autodesk Fusion release?
answer:
Based on Autodesk Fusion's October 2026 major update, the latest build in the sources is v.2706.1.17, released October 28, 2026 [6][7][8].

The October 2026 blog post (dated November 12, 2026) lists v.2706.1.14 from October 21, 2026 as the build for that update [1]. The v.2706.1.17 build, a minor update, is newer and lists stability fixes: moving components or rolling back the timeline in assemblies with inconsistent component data, and a blank Render workspace when a section analysis was active [6][7][8]. Those three sources are search snippets only, so they show little beyond that entry.
